name: job.fit
description: Project Get a Job: qualify one posting for Mike Rodgers (Head of AI / AI strategy & enablement / senior customer-facing AI deployment). Comp floor $250K all-in, reach $325K. Routes to skip / apply / warm-intro-first.

comp_band.instructions: What all-in compensation does this posting most plausibly pay? Read the posted range first and quote it; add bonus or equity language if stated. A posted BASE range sets the band unless bonus is stated. If NO pay band is posted, apply the title default instead of guessing between bands: a director-level title defaults to band_200_250k; a VP/Head-of title at a company that pays at that level defaults to band_250_325k. Pick exactly one.

criteria.below_200k: All-in clearly below $200K (a posted range whose top is under $200K)
criteria.band_200_250k: All-in $200K-$250K, or unposted with a director-level title
criteria.band_250_325k: All-in $250K-$325K, or unposted with a VP/Head-of title at a company that pays at that level
criteria.band_325k_plus: All-in $325K or more, stated or strongly implied

role_shape.instructions: Which shape best describes the job as written

criteria.head_of_ai: Owns AI strategy, governance and adoption for a business unit or company
criteria.customer_facing_ai_deployment: Deployment strategist, forward deployed, solutions or advisory role embedded with customers
criteria.ai_product_or_transformation_leader: Director/VP of AI product, transformation or enablement inside an enterprise
criteria.deep_engineering_ic: Individual contributor requiring years of hands-on ML research or large-scale systems engineering
criteria.not_a_fit: Unrelated function (finance, legal, HR, creative, medical, etc.)

hard_disqualifier.instructions: Does the posting state a hard must-have (mandatory, 'required', 'will not be considered without') that the candidate does not have? Candidate profile this rubric is bound to: enterprise AI adoption and strategy leadership, healthcare and telehealth rollout across hospital systems, Oracle/Cerner health technology, governed hands-on AI builds, senior technical product leadership. The candidate has NONE of: a PhD, an active security clearance, a professional license (law, CPA, clinical), 10+ years managing software engineering teams, hands-on SAP/ERP implementation delivery (SAP S/4HANA, Workday, NetSuite), or a named vendor certification. Preferences and nice-to-haves do not count. Quote the mandatory requirement before answering.

criteria.no_hard_must_have: No mandatory requirement matches the candidate gap list
criteria.must_have_missing: At least one mandatory requirement names something on the candidate gap list (degree, clearance, license, ERP/platform delivery, vendor certification, or N+ years in a role he has not held)

seniority_match.instructions: The seniority is Director, Senior Director, VP, Head-of or C-level. Manager-and-below or pure IC is not a match

adoption_story_fits.instructions: A candidate whose proof is enterprise AI adoption, telehealth rollout across hospital systems, Oracle/Cerner strategy, and hands-on governed AI builds would be a credible finalist for this role
